faq.label: Common Questions
faq.heading: Everything parents
faq.subheading: From curriculum alignment and child safety to offline access and AI accuracy, here are the questions parents ask most.
faq.boxText: Still have a question? Our team typically replies within 24 hours.

items.q: What age group is KidVenture designed for?
items.a: KidVenture is built specifically for primary school children aged 6 to 12. Every feature, from font sizes and layout to the complexity of games and stories, is calibrated for this age band. Parents can fine-tune content further using the three age filters inside Settings: 6–8, 9–10, and 11–12.

items.q: Is the content aligned with the Egyptian school curriculum?
items.a: Yes. Every piece of content, from flashcards and mind maps to game questions and chatbot answers, is aligned with the Egyptian Ministry of Education curriculum for Grades 1 through 6. The chatbot's RAG system is trained directly on official Ministry textbooks.

items.q: How does the AI Drawing Detection work?
items.a: A custom Convolutional Neural Network was trained on thousands of real children's drawings across more than 100 categories. When a child draws, the model analyses the sketch in under two seconds and returns encouraging, educational feedback, with over 90% recognition accuracy.

items.q: What is the I'm My Own Hero module?
items.a: I'm My Own Hero is a dedicated safety and values module made up of 6 sections. Each section contains lessons, quizzes, and short educational videos that teach children good personal habits, safety awareness, and positive religious values — all presented in a gamified, age-appropriate way.

items.q: Is KidVenture safe for children to use unsupervised?
items.a: Yes. The AI chatbot has strict guardrails that prevent off-topic responses, and all content is reviewed before it reaches the app. There are no ads, no in-app purchases visible to children, and no social features that expose children to strangers.

Core features like downloaded stories, saved flashcard sets, and stored mind maps work offline. AI-powered features such as the chatbot and drawing detection need an internet connection. Offline support is expanding with each release.

items.q: How does the Leaderboard encourage healthy competition?
items.a: The leaderboard ranks children on effort, consistency, and collaboration rather than raw scores alone. A child who completes daily tasks every day climbs faster than one who plays once and scores high, because persistence is worth more than luck here.

items.q: Is KidVenture available on both Android and iOS?
items.a: Yes. KidVenture is a Flutter application available on both platforms. Download links for Android and iOS are on the Download page. The current release is a public beta, and feedback from parents, teachers, and schools is genuinely welcome.

faq.a2: Absolutely. You can cancel your monthly or yearly subscription at any time from your account settings. No penalties, no questions asked.
faq.q3: Is Kidventure safe for my child?
faq.a3: Child safety is our top priority. All content is age-appropriate (6–8 years), the AI chatbot is filtered and monitored, and we never share your child's data with third parties.
faq.q4: What devices does Kidventure work on?
faq.a4: Kidventure is available on iOS and Android smartphones and tablets. The parental dashboard is accessible from any web browser on desktop or mobile.
faq.q5: How does the yearly plan save me money?
faq.a5: The yearly plan is priced at 449 EGP — equivalent to about 37 EGP/month — saving you 92 EGP compared to paying monthly (49 EGP × 12 = 588 EGP).
faq.a6: School pricing is customized based on the number of students and required features. Contact our sales team and we will create a tailored proposal, typically within 48 hours.
faq.q7: Does my child need internet to use Kidventure?
faq.a7: An internet connection is required for the AI chatbot and syncing progress. Core games and some stories can be accessed offline after initial download.

rotating: Now See What It's Actually Doing.
hero.desc: Your child goes on their learning adventure on the mobile app. You follow every step of it — live — on your own Parent Dashboard. No hovering. No interrupting. Just complete clarity, finally.

reality.body: The average Egyptian child spends hours daily on a screen. Less than a fraction of that is learning anything meaningful. Kidventure is the solution — for the child and for you.

pain.titleA: Every Parent We Talked to Said
pain.sub: These aren't complaints. They're signals that something needed to change.

cards.label: THE BLACK HOLE PROBLEM
cards.quote: My child spends an hour on their phone. I ask what they did — they say 'stuff.' And I just… move on.
cards.headline: When they say 'stuff' — Kidventure shows you exactly what that stuff was.
cards.body: Every story your child reads, every game they play, every quiz they answer — it all appears instantly on your Parent Dashboard. You'll see the name of the activity, the subject it covered, how long it took, and what score they got. "Stuff" becomes a detailed, real-time feed of real learning.

cards.label: THE EMPTY PROMISE PROBLEM
cards.quote: We downloaded four 'educational' apps. They were fun for three days. Then nothing. Zero actual learning.
cards.headline: Kidventure follows the exact curriculum your child studies at school. Not random content — real subjects.
cards.body: Arabic Language. Mathematics. The same topics their teacher covers every week. Every story, every game, every quiz inside Kidventure is built around the Egyptian national curriculum. So when your child finishes a Kidventure session, they haven't just been entertained — they've genuinely covered ground that matters for school.

cards.label: THE GUILT PROBLEM
cards.quote: Every time I hand them the phone, I feel like I'm giving up on them. Like I should be doing something better.
cards.headline: That guilt comes from not knowing. Kidventure replaces the not-knowing with complete confidence.
cards.body: When you can open your dashboard and see that your child just finished an Arabic comprehension story, improved their math score, and earned a badge — handing them the phone stops feeling like a compromise. It starts feeling like a genuinely good parenting decision. The guilt doesn't go away because you stop caring. It goes away because you finally have proof.

features.headline: The three numbers every parent needs to see — before they even ask.

How many activities they actually completed — not just opened. And how many new badges they earned. The most important information is always the very first thing you see.

features.headline: Not a general score. A subject-by-subject breakdown — exactly like school.

See which subject needs more attention. Have conversations with your child based on real data, not assumptions.

features.headline: A real-time record of everything they did — in the exact order they did it.

features.headline: When they come running to show you what they earned — you'll already be celebrating.
features.body: Every badge your child unlocks on their mobile app appears on your dashboard instantly. You'll know the moment they earn it. And when they burst through the door to tell you — you'll be ready. Because you were watching the whole time.

curriculum.body: We didn't pick random topics. We didn't make up a curriculum. We followed the Egyptian national curriculum — the exact program your child's teacher uses, the exact subjects they'll be examined on, the exact material that shows up in their school grades.
curriculum.body2: Arabic Language comprehension and vocabulary. Mathematics reasoning and problem solving. Every piece of content inside Kidventure was built to reinforce what's already being taught in the classroom.

safety.titleA: Your Child's Safety Isn't a Feature.
safety.sub: Before we wrote a single line of code, we answered one question: would we trust this with our own children?

cards.title: AI Content Filtering
cards.body: Every conversation with the Kidventure AI is filtered in real-time. Only learning topics are allowed. If a question goes outside safe educational content, the AI redirects — every single time.

cards.title: Zero Ads — Ever
cards.body: No advertisements. No sponsored content. No external links. No pop-ups. The only things on your child's screen are the things we put there — deliberately, for learning and growth.

cards.title: Egyptian Curriculum Only
cards.body: Every story, every game, every quiz is built around the official Egyptian national curriculum. Everything is curated, reviewed, and appropriate for the age group.

cards.title: Parent Gate
cards.body: A PIN-protected section that only you control. Your child cannot change settings, access restricted features, or exit the learning environment without your permission.

cards.title: Data Privacy — Always
cards.body: Your child's personal information is never sold, never shared with advertisers, never used for anything other than improving their learning experience. Yours to delete at any time.

cards.title: Full Parent Visibility
cards.body: You always know what your child is doing, what they've done, and what they're learning. Complete transparency — by design, not as an afterthought.

faq.stillQ: Still have questions? We're here — we respond fast.

items.q: Can I track more than one child on the same account?
items.a: Yes — completely. Each child has their own separate profile, dashboard, progress bars, activity feed, and badges. Switching between them takes one tap.

items.q: Is the Parent Dashboard available on my phone, or only on a computer?
items.a: The dashboard works on any browser — desktop, laptop, tablet, or phone.

items.q: How quickly does the dashboard update after my child does something?
items.a: In real-time. The moment your child completes an activity, earns a badge, or finishes a story — it appears on your dashboard within seconds. It updates automatically.

items.q: What exactly does "Progress by Subject" show me?
items.a: A visual progress bar for each subject — Arabic Language, Mathematics, and others — showing how much of the curriculum your child has covered and how much remains.

items.q: Can my child access the parent dashboard?

items.q: What if my child doesn't use the app for a few days?

items.q: Do I need to pay to see the Parent Dashboard?

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.q1: How do I create a parent account?
gettingStarted.a1: Visit the Kidventure website and click Sign Up. Enter your name, email, and password, then agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to create your account.
gettingStarted.q2: How do I add my child's profile?
gettingStarted.a2: After logging in to your dashboard, go to Profiles and select Add Child. Enter your child's name, age, and choose an avatar to create their learning profile.
gettingStarted.q3: How do I download the mobile app?
gettingStarted.a3: Download Kidventure for Android from Google Play or for iOS from the App Store. You can also scan the QR code on our download page.
gettingStarted.q4: Do I need an internet connection to use the app?
gettingStarted.a4: Most features require an internet connection. Flashcards and mind maps can be used offline, while quizzes, the AI chatbot, and drawing detection need an active connection.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions & Billing
subscriptions.a1: Kidventure offers Monthly and Annual plans. The Annual plan includes a discount compared to paying month to month.
subscriptions.q2: How do I change or cancel my subscription?
subscriptions.a2: Go to your Parental Dashboard, open the Subscription page, and select Manage Plan. From there you can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time.
subscriptions.a3: Yes. All payments are processed through a PCI-compliant payment gateway. Kidventure never stores your card details on its servers.
subscriptions.q4: Will I be charged automatically when my plan renews?
subscriptions.a4: Yes, subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing cycle unless you cancel beforehand from your dashboard.

mobileApp.title: Using the Mobile App
mobileApp.q1: What can my child do in the app?
mobileApp.a1: Children can explore Interactive Stories, play Educational Games, take Quizzes, use Flashcards and Mind Maps, view 3D Models, chat with the AI guide, and try Drawing Detection.
mobileApp.q2: How does the Drawing Detection feature work?
mobileApp.a2: Your child draws on the digital canvas, then taps Scan Drawing. The AI model identifies the object and shows a card confirming what was drawn along with fun facts.
mobileApp.q3: How does the AI Chatbot work?
mobileApp.a3: Your child can type or speak a question to the friendly AI guide. Answers are based on approved educational content and are limited to age-appropriate topics.
mobileApp.q4: How do I access parental settings inside the app?
mobileApp.a4: Tap the small gear icon on the Home Screen, then select Parental Section. You will be asked to solve a simple math question to confirm you are an adult.

dashboard.title: Parent Dashboard
dashboard.q1: How do I view my child's progress?
dashboard.a1: Log in to the web dashboard and select your child's profile. The Progress by Subject widget shows completion bars for each learning area.
dashboard.q2: What do the badges and stars mean?
dashboard.a2: Stars are earned for completing activities, while badges are awarded for reaching specific milestones such as finishing a story or mastering a topic.
dashboard.q3: Can I see how much time my child spends on the app?
dashboard.a3: Yes. The At a Glance widget shows time spent this week, activities completed, and any new badges earned.

safety.title: Safety & Privacy
safety.q1: Is the content appropriate for young children?
safety.a1: Yes. All AI responses are limited to educational topics and avoid sensitive subjects such as politics, religion, or gender, keeping the experience age-appropriate.
safety.q2: What is the I Am My Own Hero module?
safety.a2: It is a calm, non-gamified module that teaches children about personal safety, body boundaries, and trusted adults through simple lessons.
safety.q3: How is my child's data protected?
safety.a3: Kidventure follows Privacy by Design principles, requires parental consent for child accounts, and lets parents request deletion of their child's data at any time.

account.title: Account & Security
account.q1: I forgot my password. What should I do?
account.a1: On the login page, select Forgot Password and follow the instructions sent to your email to reset it securely.
account.q2: Can I log in with my Google account?
account.a2: Yes, you can use Continue with Google on the login or registration page to sign in without a password.
account.q3: How do I update my email or account details?
account.a3: Go to your Dashboard, open Profile Settings, and edit your account information. Confirm changes to save them.
